scope: Synchronous scalar callable fields and managed capture environments in recursive CPU values

implementation.admission: Named/anonymous scalar functions, references and indirect calls now work in recursive units; structural signatures are checked for synchronous completed values
implementation.capture_layout: Internal records describe capture payloads without changing source nominal identities; the existing recursive emitter boxes their transitive backing
implementation.ownership: Function fields retain their bound managed environment; environments retain captured String, collection, record and nested-function backing
implementation.validation: Environments bind once before pair publication; active field collection validates code/environment identity and checked wrappers validate owned backing, code identity and exact bytes before loading captures
implementation.separation: Acyclic source retains its previous environment allocation path; recursive function arrays, errors, worker/GPU and public export paths remain rejected
implementation.legacy_tests: Outdated negative tests for fn(Config)->int fields were replaced with positive invocation coverage; an actual impossible direct storage cycle remains rejected

groups.failures: Four legacy callable-field suites retained obsolete rejection expectations for nominal self-signatures

groups.reason: Updated rejection/positive coverage; implementation unchanged from broader qualification

coverage: Named and capture-free anonymous functions in recursive fields
Returned nodes and owned String/numeric/Bool/String-array and tensor captures
Nested captured function values and transitive environment ownership
Recursive record captures and recursive record results
Immutable record updates and callbacks inside record arrays
Nominal recursive parameters and structural signature guards
Retained node keeps environment and captured String bytes after invocation settlement
Final owner/environment release drops captured backing edges
Inactive invalid pairs ignored; null, mismatched, unknown, foreign and ordinary unqualified environments rejected
Rebinding, wrong payload size and invalid active flags rejected; cancelled reads stop
Existing nonrecursive callable, closure, function-value, record-closure, semantic and recursive ownership regressions
qualification.format: Changed C++ ranges formatted; recursive bridge/emitter/source test files pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes

limitations: Function arrays and callable signatures containing function arrays remain rejected in recursive units
Fallible/task/device signatures, application-error control, workers, parallel groups, continuation planning, GPU and public bridge exports remain rejected for recursive units
Backing retention after settlement does not make a settled invocation callable or implement worker ownership transfer
Code pointers are compiler-owned; private helpers are not an arbitrary foreign callback validation API
Allocation, signature, work, stack and call-depth limits remain in force; earlier reclamation and copy/owner compaction remain optimization work
